title: Craig-Bampton-based Quadratic Manifold for Nonlinear Substructuring
summary: Component Mode Synthesis methods, such as the Craig-Bampton (CB) approach, are widely used in structural dynamics due to their modularity and compatibility with substructuring workflows. While highly effective for linear systems, extending these methods to geometrically nonlinear structures remains a significant challenge. In this work, we propose a nonlinear extension of the CB method tailored to such contexts.
